text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I searched for Zenno Rob Roy, who hadn't 
shown up despite it being time for 
training, and found her on a hill...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! Look at this cityscape. The 
buildings and the park's location... 
there's no doubt about it!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"This town was the model for where the 
protagonist grew up! The scene where they 
train by running all around town was so 
memorable—"
choice_data_list:
Looks like it's time for your training 
too.
Time for your training too, huh?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! I-I-I'm so sorry! What have I 
done...?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy got too caught up 
researching the book and ended up skipping 
training. I warned her to be more careful 
in the future.
